title: Tip #9: Use Emotional Landscapes
use_cases: Use when crafting a setting that mirrors the protagonist's emotional arc
Implement when you want the environment to reinforce plot themes
Configure when designing game terrain to match narrative mood
Apply when generating descriptions that evoke specific feelings
content:
As any good real-estate agent will tell you, the secret it: location, location, location!

I'm not a real-estate agent (and I don't intend to be one, although you never know) but the rule stands in fantasy worldbuilding as well. Think about how the landscape can reflect the emotional tone of your story or the inner world of your characters.
